title: Retro CRT
line: An old terminal: phosphor green mono type, an amber accent, scanlines, tape wobble and chiptune.
line_zh: 一台老终端：荧光绿等宽字，琥珀点缀，扫描线、磁带抖动与芯片音乐。
prompt: Retro CRT style: phosphor-green mono type on black, one amber accent, scanlines with a light tape wobble and glow, glitch-split and typewriter type, static and glitch cuts, a chiptune bed with key clicks and a glitch stutter.
prompt_zh: 复古显像管风格：黑底荧光绿等宽字，一抹琥珀色，扫描线加轻微磁带抖动与辉光，故障分裂与打字机字效，雪花与故障切换，芯片音乐配乐，配按键声与故障卡顿声。
essence: A screen from another decade: glowing mono characters, a little signal noise and sounds made by chips. The noise frames the words; the words stay sharp.

not.difference: Neon Night is soft bloom and bokeh in a sans face; Retro CRT is a mono terminal with scanlines.
Blueprint is a clean drawing; Retro CRT is a noisy glowing screen.

palette.logic: near-black glass, phosphor green ink, ONE amber for the cursor and the key word

camera.expresses: a beat-locked punch on the terminal

sound.foley: key clicks, a glitch stutter and an electric arc

signature_features.text: phosphor green ink on black at 15:1, amber at 10:1 (contrast.py)
a mono face typed out, the name glitch-split
static, glitch and pixel-sort cuts only
a chiptune bed with key and glitch sounds
scanlines and wobble frame the words; the letters stay sharp

demo.lint: mp lint 100.0/100, 56 PASS, 0 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
